obligations.statement: ISO/IEC 42005:2025 gives guidance for organizations conducting AI system impact assessments: how an AI system, and its foreseeable applications, may affect individuals, groups of individuals and society, across the system’s life cycle. It is guidance, not a set of requirements, and it is not certifiable. An organization that has adopted ISO/IEC 42001:2023 can use it to carry out the impact assessments of Annex A, controls A.5.2 to A.5.5.
